description: Rotation2 / Rotation3 completion: from_matrix, slerp, rotation_to, division, products with unit complex numbers and unit quaternions, new, powf, angle_to, axis_angle, euler_angles_ordered, look_at_lh

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: rotation2_from_matrix
ops.doc: Rotation2::from_matrix(&m) (upstream's iteration, checked against the closed form)
ops.tolerance: ceil(32 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation2_slerp
ops.tolerance: ceil(32 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation2_rotation_to
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation2_div
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation2_mul_unit_complex
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation2_div_unit_complex
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation3_new
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_powf
ops.doc: r.powf(n), n in [-2, 2], angle of r < 3
ops.tolerance: ceil(32 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_angle_to
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_div
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit
